Ingrid

I never fathomed it, though I did dream about it
I want to feel Wilson.
Touch every part of him.
Kiss every inch of him.
But no matter how I suppress it,
There's another woman inside me
Who wants John to hold her.
Touch every part of her.
Kiss every inch of her.

Is the one you want the person you love?

Ingrid McDaniels, inspired by her friend Alicia Steele, decides to have children without having the need for a father. Her evil uncle wants to steal her corporation and messes up her plan by contracting two younger cowboys. They are to make Ingrid fall madly and crazy in love with them.

Will Ingrid fall into the trap, or will it be the cowboys? Or will it be the three of them? Will they have a happy ending or even a shot at happiness?

Find out in Deflowered by my Cowboys from the Deflowered Series. This is a new standalone series from bestselling author Kat T. Scott.

Author's Note: Each book in this series is a STAND-ALONE and can be read in any order. No Cliffy, no cheating. Just Loads of swoons, sparks and bedroom steam just for you!
